settings.description: Timeless essentials designed for the modern wardrobe. Quality fabrics, minimal design, built to last.

settings.heading: Our Philosophy
settings.body_text: We believe great clothing starts with restraint. Every piece in the NOIR collection is designed to be versatile, durable, and effortlessly stylish. No logos. No trends. Just quality.
settings.fulfillment_note: All garments are manufactured and fulfilled by Tapstitch using premium heavyweight blanks, DTG printing, and custom branding.
